$comment: FIX-1176 — hand-edited duration bands for pnpm receipts:daily. The script NEVER writes this file. Keys are pg_cron job NAMES (jobids are not portable between prod and the clone — CLAUDE.md, FIX-946); the one key with a colon is a job:unit band, read from that run row's unit_seconds rather than from the job's wall time. A job with no key here gets verdict `no-band`, never `in-band`. Every entry carries a `source` — an unsourced band is folklore. SEEDED ONLY FROM NUMBERS STATED AS BANDS in cc-prompt-117/118/123 and nightly.yml's cron header; nothing here was measured by this commit, per cc-123's Out of scope. Add a band by writing lo_s, hi_s and a source that says where the numbers came from and over how many runs.

rule-taggers-daily.source: cc-169 (FIX-1178), RE-BASED on the merge regime: prod cron.job_run_details walls 2026-09-23..2026-09-29, n=7, 203.3-225.7 s; P10 204.14 / P90 225.31 (percentile_cont); band = [P10 - 10%, P90 + 15%] = [183.73, 259.11] rounded outward. Post-mechanism-change runs only (rule 74) - the daily went from DELETE-all + INSERT-all to a scan/delete/insert merge on Pro at 2026-09-23 00:03 UTC. Superseded band: 713-858 s (cc-prompt-117 Phase 0 read 6 / cc-prompt-118 Item 5, the rewrite regime).

ec-vacuum-analyze.source: cc-prompt-123 D3 (<= 140 quiet-day). Consistent with cc-prompt-117 Phase 0 read 4, which made a quiet-day EC run > 120 s the trigger for the pg_class-keyed gate, and with FIX-1169's series (124 s / 133 s over its first points, cc-prompt-118 Item 5).

fe-vacuum-analyze.source: BORROWED, not independently derived: FIX-1169's series reports ec- and fe-vacuum-analyze together (124 s / 133 s, cc-prompt-118 Item 5) and cc-prompt-123 D3 names only the EC ceiling. Re-derive from this job's own series once the receipts file has collected one.

votes-vacuum-analyze.source: PROVISIONAL, n=1 (cc-192, FIX-1238). Taken from the job's first firing: prod cron.job_run_details 2026-10-03T02:37:00Z, wall 24.8 s, succeeded. hi_s is 24.8 s + 15 % = 28.52 s, rounded up; that is the re-base rule's upper margin applied to the one point. lo_s is 0, as for the other vacuum bands. That firing cleared a backlog: the 2026-10-02 04:25 pre-ec probe read votes at 31,826 dead tuples and 82.6 % all-visible, and the 10-03 and 10-04 probes read 0 dead and 100 %. Later firings should find almost nothing to clean, so this ceiling is probably loose. Re-derive from five firings (the fifth is 2026-10-31) with [P10 - 10 %, P90 + 15 %].

donor-rollup-refresh.source: cc-prompt-123 D3 (09:00 firing <= 400 / 12:00 firing ~ 0). THE SCHEMA CANNOT EXPRESS THE SECOND HALF: bands are keyed by job name only, and this job's two daily firings have different expected costs, so the looser ceiling is used and the 12:00 firing is trivially in-band. See docs/receipts/README.md.

refresh-derived-mvs-daily:rebuild_entity.source: cc-prompt-123 D3 and cc-prompt-117 Phase 0 read 5 (FIX-1152's receipt: < 300 s expected; Mon 2026-09-07 was 236.0 s at 88.8% EC all-visible; the failure mode was 1,017 s at 79%). A UNIT band, not a job band — section 3 reports it from the run row's unit_seconds.
